name: agent-skill-catalog
input_contract: One or more explicit local roots containing SKILL.md files (each labeled `skill` or `plugin`), plus optional scoped overrides and image metadata. Missing family-primary repository links may be searched in a bounded concurrent GitHub pass unless discovery is disabled; search only generates candidates, and automatic association requires a matching remote SKILL.md plus a unique high-confidence evidence result.
output_contract: Deterministic catalog.json, description-enrichment.json, resumable description-batch.json workflow, and self-contained index.html with skills, plugin aggregates, families, category evidence, confidence, Agent-reviewed Chinese descriptions, best-evidence aggregate images, invocation, GitHub metadata, cached GitHub previews, and output-owned manual overrides. Two named build outcomes exist: a default Preview build (exit code 0 with a readable index.html even while Chinese descriptions remain pending) and an opt-in Enriched completion, requested with --require-complete-descriptions, which additionally requires pending_description_count to be zero.
rollback_boundary: Only the selected output directory may be overwritten. GitHub preview cache and manual image overrides stay inside that directory. Scanned roots are read-only for scanning, building, image selection, and refresh; the single exception is an explicit, opt-in localhost-server deletion of one top-level standalone Skill, which runs only when the serving config marks that root `allow_delete: true` and the full Skill name is confirmed, and is disabled by default in every shipped config.
network_policy: Network is opt-out, not opt-in. Unless disabled, a build may perform bounded HTTPS GitHub candidate search and remote SKILL.md verification, observed or verified repository-page reads, bounded README excerpts, and allowlisted GitHub image-host fetches; these reads may reuse an existing gh/token login and never store credentials. Use --no-github-discovery --no-github-images for an offline build, and also --no-github-readmes when processing the description queue.
review_notes: For every public release, review trigger behavior, output quality, permission scope, trust evidence, package contents, and clean-install results.
